purpose: Diagnose what R91 actually learned, identify the cause of its trade-offs, and decide whether the prepared R92 design needs a targeted revision before formal execution.
candidate_role: research diagnosis only; this protocol does not promote R91 or authorize R92 formal training

reasons.6: Last conservative stage before the model begins making large clear-input changes.
reasons.34: Recovery phase with the smallest clear-input change among reconstruction-active late stages.
reasons.40: Previously inspected transition stage and the only R91 stage with an existing fixed SEM comparison.
reasons.52: Late stage where contour and motion have improved while the final plateau has not yet completed.
reasons.60: Completed final checkpoint with the strongest stored degraded contour and exposure performance.

inference_contract.bf16_role: numerical sensitivity and speed diagnostic only
inference_contract.reason_added_after_precision_audit: The pre-existing R91 E40 SEM reconstruction is effectively FP32. BF16 changes the image by only about 0.31 gray on average but can cause the fixed ACM rule to select a different contour on ambiguous transitions. Shape-bearing comparisons therefore require one locked precision.

stored_synthetic_trajectory.population: Every stored R91 validation checkpoint from epoch 1 through epoch 60.
stored_synthetic_trajectory.corrected_detail_metric: Use degraded textured-general observations only; keep clear-input absolute change separate instead of dividing by a near-zero Raw texture error.

fixed_real_appearance.interpretation: Raw-paired appearance and artifact diagnostics only; these images have no pixel-aligned truth target.

fixed_live_branch_probe.interpretation: Measure how much the broad, detail, and edge branches alter the same 5x, 20x, and 50x frames.

sem_contour.interpretation: Primary shape-accuracy arm. The contour rule, SEM pairing, and translation-only alignment remain fixed.

real_motion.interpretation: Stability relative to the commanded stage motion, using the pre-locked 30 steps. External GMF is unavailable, so this arm uses the audited multi-threshold contour readout and a GMF-like phase readout.

tiled_reconstruction.interpretation: Numerical full-canvas versus canonical tiled parity on a real frame.

decision_policy.method: Inspect the complete stored trajectory, then compare representative stages on identical real inputs. Do not use a single weighted average or a visually selected subset.
claim_limits: Appearance metrics show reconstruction strength and artifact risk, not truth accuracy.
SEM supports contour claims only for the paired 36 pillars and 12 optical exposures.
Motion supports stability on the tested 50x x_1um sequence, not absolute stage accuracy.
No result from this protocol changes the formal project baseline.
